description: Capability for the main window and every overlay window (Interview Mode, Sales Mode, Consulting Mode, and one per Custom Agent). Tauri 2 scopes IPC/permissions per window label, so any window missing from this list — including a new agent's `agent-overlay-<id>` window — silently loses every command invoke and window action (drag, etc.) even though the window itself still renders. The wildcard covers agent overlays since their label is dynamic and can't be enumerated ahead of time.
